text:
lina: quick flag 1 saw a tenant report where their console shows v2 latency spike but billing graphs show tokens billed to v1. digging into routing_events shows a bunch of "fallback_to_variant=v1" entries during the eu-central outage window.
samir: ugh. were those fallbacks expected? I thought our policy was to only fallback within the same model family (v2->v2-compat) not to v1 unless explicit allowlist.
jordan: policy changed last month for short-lived emergency fallbacks: if no compatible v2 variant in region AND cross-region latency budget allows, we fall back to highest-compat model available. looks like v1 got selected because we didn't have a v2-quantized replica in us-west.
lina: right. problem: console attribution is inconsistent. frontend dashboards show requested_model=v2 (from request header) but billing pipeline ingests served_model from the inference logs (v1). we end up with two different views and it confuses customers.
ops-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-8422 for investigating routing mismatch.
ravi: short term: emit an explicit event field route.fallback_target and route.fallback_layer in routing_events kafka topic. that way downstream consumers (billing, console) can join on the same event stream instead of inferring.
elaine: agree. long term: we should standardize on an authoritative "model_resolution" event that includes requested_model, final_served_model, serve_region, fallback_reason enum (NONE/CAPACITY/REGION_UNAVAILABLE/FAILED_PREFILTER), and a request_id to join traces.
samir: watch cardinality explosion if we add serve_region string. propose using a coarse region tag: same_region, cross_region_same_cloud, cross_cloud. and keep raw region only in sampled traces.
jordan: also add a "served_model_stability" boolean indicating if we served the exact pinned version customers asked for vs a compatible substitute. that helps legal/compliance questions.
lina: UX asks: 1) console should show a reconciliation panel per-tenant for last 24h that highlights requests where requested_model != served_model along with percentage and example trace links. 2) add a billing reconciliation run that flags tenant if billed_tokens attribution differs >1% from requested_token estimate.
elaine: for alerts, suggest two flavors: operational (internal) alert when >0.5% of global traffic has mismatched attribution in 5m window; customer-facing email when a tenant experiences >2% mismatch over 24h with >100k tokens.
ravi: implementation note: billing system currently aggregates tokens per served_model. We need a dual-write path for 30 days where we write both billed_by_served_model and billed_by_requested_model into billing_pendings table. After reconciliation window, decide canonical attribution and switch column.
samir: SDK-level consent: we should add header "x-rw-allow-degenerate-fallback" with values yes/ask/deny. Default ask for newer SDKs to surface prompt to devs. But for server-to-server flows we default to yes to avoid downtime. Needs product decision.
jordan: product/ops tradeoff: opt-in for cross-region fallback reduces availability risk for some customers. I'd rather we make default opt-out for high-compliance tenants and opt-in for general purpose. Need tenant config in console with explicit fallback policy override.
lina: timeline proposal: week 0: telemetry schema change + coarse region buckets + route.fallback_target field. week 1: billing dual-write + reconciliation job + internal alert. week 2: console reconciliation panel + banner for affected tenants. week 4: SDK header rollout and console tenant toggle.
elaine: tests: add end-to-end test that replays routing_events into billing pipeline to ensure reconciliation works for sample tenants. and a dashboard smoke test that will detect when requested_model != served_model > threshold in staging.
ravi: note: kafka topic schema change needs coordination: add new optional fields with default nulls, update consumers to ignore unknown fields. will post a PR to infra.
samir: UX copy for banner draft: "We've detected that some of your requests were served by alternate model variants during recent capacity events. This can affect latency and billed model attribution. Review details in Reconciliation > Model Attribution."
jordan: add a CTA to download CSV of mismatched requests for audit.
lina: great. who volunteers for the telemetry PR?
samir: I'll take the kafka producer change and the coarse-region mapping.
jordan: I'll update routing service to populate fallback_reason and fallback_target.
ravi: I'll own the billing dual-write and reconciliation job.
elaine: I'll wire up the console panel and banner.
lina: thanks team. filing RFC for this change and will schedule a 30-min sync with product to confirm defaults and customer-facing language. :sparkles:
